batchRequest.request: Assign the unassigned pitch to Mira, add a fact-check deadline column and mark the first pitch ready for editing.

chunks.text: Mira is also added to the

patchOf:
root = Stack([header, pitchesCard, formCard])
header = CardHeader("Assignment Desk", "Six active pitches and a place to submit new ones")
pitchesCard = Card([pitchesHeader, pitchTable])
pitchesHeader = InlineHeader("Active Pitches", "Reporter, deadline and reporting stage")
pitchTable = Table([Col("Pitch", titles), Col("Reporter", reporters), Col("Deadline", deadlines), Col("Stage", stageTags), Col("Assignment", assignTags)])
titles = ["City budget shortfall", "Port strike impact on retailers", "School bus driver shortage", "Hospital wait times investigation", "Local election profile: District 4", "Wildfire smoke and air quality"]
reporters = ["Maria Lopez", "Dan Whitfield", "Unassigned", "Priya Nair", "Unassigned", "Tom Okafor"]
deadlines = ["2025-06-12", "2025-06-10", "2025-06-18", "2025-06-25", "2025-06-20", "2025-06-09"]
stageTags = [st1, st2, st3, st4, st5, st6]
st1 = Tag("Drafting", null, "sm", "info")
st2 = Tag("Editing", null, "sm", "warning")
st3 = Tag("Pitched", null, "sm", "neutral")
st4 = Tag("Reporting", null, "sm", "info")
st5 = Tag("Pitched", null, "sm", "neutral")
st6 = Tag("Ready to publish", null, "sm", "success")
assignTags = [as1, as2, as3, as4, as5, as6]
as1 = Tag("Assigned", null, "sm", "success")
as2 = Tag("Assigned", null, "sm", "success")
as3 = Tag("Unassigned", null, "sm", "danger")
as4 = Tag("Assigned", null, "sm", "success")
as5 = Tag("Unassigned", null, "sm", "danger")
as6 = Tag("Assigned", null, "sm", "success")
formCard = Card([formHeader, pitchForm])
formHeader = InlineHeader("Submit a Pitch", "Share a story idea with the desk")
pitchForm = Form("pitch", formBtns, [fTitle, fReporter, fDeadline, fStage, fSummary])
fTitle = FormControl("Working headline", Input("headline", "e.g. Transit fare hike explained", "text", { required: true, minLength: 5 }))
fReporter = FormControl("Reporter", Select("reporter", reporterOpts, "Select reporter or leave unassigned"), "Leave blank if unassigned")
reporterOpts = [SelectItem("unassigned", "Unassigned"), SelectItem("lopez", "Maria Lopez"), SelectItem("whitfield", "Dan Whitfield"), SelectItem("nair", "Priya Nair"), SelectItem("okafor", "Tom Okafor")]
fDeadline = FormControl("Deadline", DatePicker("deadline", "single", { required: true }))
fStage = FormControl("Reporting stage", Select("stage", stageOpts, "Select stage", { required: true }))
stageOpts = [SelectItem("pitched", "Pitched"), SelectItem("reporting", "Reporting"), SelectItem("drafting", "Drafting"), SelectItem("editing", "Editing"), SelectItem("ready", "Ready to publish")]
fSummary = FormControl("Summary", TextArea("summary", "Describe the angle, sources and why it matters now...", 4, { required: true, minLength: 20 }))
formBtns = Buttons([Button("Submit Pitch", @ToAssistant("Submit new pitch"), "primary"), Button("Clear", @ToAssistant("Clear pitch form"), "secondary")])
request: Assign the unassigned pitch to Mira, add a fact-check deadline column and mark the first pitch ready for editing.
